title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Bite Shoes Pharaoh's Servant PSV-080 Common / Short Print Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: This Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG card is a 1st edition common card with the card number PSV-080. It features the effect type and the creature/monster type is fiend. The card name is Bite Shoes and it is manufactured by Konami. The card belongs to the Pharaoh's Servant set and has the attribute/MTG color dark. The attack/power is 500 and the defense/toughness is 300. This card is perfect for collectors and players of the Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG game.
